recitals: This Compliance Certificate is delivered by Rennick Harbours Limited (the "Obligor") to Thornbeck Corporate Trustee Limited (the "Security Trustee") pursuant to Clause 8.2 (Compliance Certificates) of the common terms agreement dated 14 March 2019 between, among others, the Obligor, Rennick Harbours Holdings plc, Rennick Harbours Finance plc and the Security Trustee (as amended, restated and supplemented from time to time, the "Common Terms Agreement"). Terms defined in the Common Terms Agreement have the same meaning when used in this Certificate unless expressly given a different meaning in it.

The Calculation Date to which this Certificate relates is 30 June 2026 and the Relevant Period is the period of twelve months ended on that date. The financial ratios set out in Schedule 1 (Interest Cover Ratio) and Schedule 2 (Leverage Ratio) have been calculated in respect of that Relevant Period in accordance with Schedule 4 (Financial Definitions and Calculations) of the Common Terms Agreement, and no adjustment, cure amount or pro forma item has been applied other than as permitted by that Schedule.

The figures set out in the Schedules have been extracted from the unaudited consolidated management accounts of the Security Group for the six months ended 30 June 2026, read together with the audited consolidated financial statements of the Security Group for the financial year ended 31 December 2025, in each case prepared on a basis consistent with that applied in the preparation of the Original Financial Statements. There has been no change in the accounting basis, policies or reference periods of the Security Group since the date of the Original Financial Statements which would require restatement under Clause 8.4 (Accounting Basis).

We confirm that, at the Calculation Date, the Interest Cover Ratio was 2.92:1 and the Leverage Ratio was 5.53:1, and that each such ratio is within the levels prescribed by Clause 9.1 (Financial Covenants) of the Common Terms Agreement. Accordingly, no Trigger Event has occurred in respect of either ratio tested by this Certificate.

Having made due enquiry, and on the basis of the Approved Business Plan most recently delivered to the Security Trustee together with the assumptions stated in it, we confirm that we do not expect the Interest Cover Ratio to fall below, or the Leverage Ratio to exceed, the relevant Trigger Event level in respect of either of the two Relevant Periods ending after the Calculation Date, and that no Trigger Event is projected to occur during that forward-looking period.

We further confirm that no Default and no Trigger Event has occurred and is continuing at the date of this Certificate and that, so far as we are aware after due enquiry, no Default or Trigger Event is reasonably likely to occur as a result of any matter subsisting at that date. Should any Default or Trigger Event subsequently occur, we shall notify the Security Trustee in accordance with Clause 8.6 (Notification of Default).

This Certificate is given by the undersigned Authorised Signatories for and on behalf of the Obligor and not in any personal capacity, and a copy has been delivered to Penhurst Agency Services Limited, as Facility Agent, and to Ashvale Fiduciary Services Limited, as Bond Trustee, in accordance with Clause 8.2(c) of the Common Terms Agreement.

That ratio is not less than the Trigger Event level of 1.85:1 and is not less than the Event of Default level of 1.50:1. Accordingly, the Obligor is in compliance with Clause 9.1(a) (Interest Cover Ratio) and no Trigger Event has occurred.

agreement.name: Common Terms Agreement (as amended and restated on 3 June 2021)

recitals: This Compliance Certificate is delivered to the Security Trustee pursuant to Clause 17.2 (Compliance Certificates) of the Common Terms Agreement dated 14 September 2012, as amended and restated on 3 June 2021, made between, among others, Cawdrey Crossing Operations Limited as Obligor, Cawdrey Crossing Finance PLC as Issuer, Cawdrey Crossing Holdings Limited as Parent and Calderwell Corporate Trustees Limited as Security Trustee (the "Common Terms Agreement"). Terms defined in the Common Terms Agreement bear the same meaning when used in this Certificate unless otherwise defined in it.

This Certificate is given in respect of the Calculation Date falling on 31 March 2026 and relates to the Test Period of twelve months ending on that date. It is delivered together with the audited consolidated financial statements of the Obligor for the financial year ended 31 March 2026.

Schedule 1 to this Certificate sets out the calculation of the Historic Debt Service Cover Ratio for the Test Period. Historic Consolidated Cashflow and Historic Consolidated Debt Service have each been derived from those financial statements and computed in accordance with Part 1 of Schedule 4 (Financial Covenants) to the Common Terms Agreement, applying the accounting principles referred to in Clause 16.1 (Financial Definitions). The Historic Debt Service Cover Ratio for the Test Period is 1.44:1.

We confirm that the Projected DSCR calculated as at the same Calculation Date for the twelve month period ending 31 March 2027, on the basis of the Base Case then in effect, is 1.52:1 and accordingly is not less than the Trigger Event ratio level of 1.20:1. No circumstance has arisen since the Calculation Date, and we are aware of no circumstance likely to arise, which would cause the Projected DSCR to fall below that level.

The forward-looking calculation in paragraph 4 has been prepared on assumptions which the directors of the Obligor consider reasonable as at the date of this Certificate, including as to traffic volumes, the indexation of the Regulated Toll and the completion of the northbound approach resurfacing programme within the current Authorised Budget.

No Default and no Trigger Event has occurred and is continuing as at the date of this Certificate, and none would result from the making of any Restricted Payment presently contemplated by the Obligor. No amount standing to the credit of the Debt Service Reserve Account has been drawn during the Test Period, and the balance of that account satisfies the Required Balance.
The Obligor is in compliance with each of the financial covenants set out in Schedule 4 (Financial Covenants) to the Common Terms Agreement as at the Calculation Date.

This Certificate is given by the persons signing below in their capacity as directors of the Obligor and not so as to incur any personal liability, and may be relied upon by the Security Trustee, the Bond Trustee and each Secured Creditor.

agreement.name: Common Terms Agreement (as amended and restated on 9 June 2021)

recitals: This is a Compliance Certificate delivered pursuant to Clause 8.2 (Compliance Certificates) of the common terms agreement dated 14 October 2013 and amended and restated on 9 June 2021 between, among others, Ravensmoor Water Limited ("RAL") as Borrower, Ravensmoor Water Holdings Limited as Parent, Ravensmoor Funding PLC as Issuer and Aldermoor Corporate Trustees Limited as Borrower Security Trustee (the "Common Terms Agreement"). Terms defined in the Common Terms Agreement have the same meaning when used in this Certificate unless given a different meaning here.

The Calculation Date to which this Certificate relates is 31 March 2026 and the Relevant Period is the period of twelve months ending on that date. This Certificate is delivered within the period required by Clause 8.2.2 of the Common Terms Agreement.

Schedule 1 to this Certificate sets out the computation of the Senior Interest Cover Ratio and Schedule 2 sets out the computation of the Senior Regulatory Asset Ratio, in each case as at, and in respect of the Relevant Period ending on, the Calculation Date. Each ratio has been calculated in accordance with Part 1 of Schedule 4 (Financial Covenants) to the Common Terms Agreement, applying the Accounting Principles consistently, and is derived from the audited consolidated financial statements of the Ravensmoor Security Group for the financial year ended 31 March 2026 and from the Regulatory Asset Base determined in accordance with the Licence.

We confirm that the Regulatory Asset Base of the Ravensmoor Security Group at the Calculation Date is £3,145.0m and that the deduction of two per cent of RAB required by paragraph 2(c) of Part 1 of Schedule 4 has been made in arriving at Cash Flow (A) in Schedule 1.

On the basis of the Board-approved business plan most recently delivered under Clause 8.4 (Business Plan), and applying the assumptions set out in that plan, we confirm that the Senior Interest Cover Ratio and the Senior Regulatory Asset Ratio are each forecast, for each of the two Relevant Periods ending 31 March 2027 and 31 March 2028, to remain within the levels specified in Part 2 of Schedule 4 (Financial Covenants), and that no Trigger Event is expected to occur in either of those periods.

We confirm that no Default and no Trigger Event has occurred and is continuing at the date of this Certificate, and that no Default or Trigger Event has occurred since the date of the Compliance Certificate last delivered which has not been remedied or waived in accordance with the Common Terms Agreement.

Accordingly, the Obligors confirm that they were in compliance with each Financial Covenant set out in Part 1 of Schedule 4 (Financial Covenants) to the Common Terms Agreement as at the Calculation Date.
This Certificate is given by the undersigned for and on behalf of each Obligor in their capacity as Authorised Signatories and without incurring any personal liability.
